preserve: every old /work/api/namespace/* and /recent-files path the page called that a file tool made into a call is answered by that tool's door operation, with the input the old route took
a file name never travels in a GET's URL: GET /namespace/files/<x>, /namespace/contents/<x> and /namespace/results/<x> refuse anything but a content identity
GET /records/<id> is records:read {id}, the id percent-decoded, and the records paths old trillion answered by other owners are not ids
a query limit counts only as a whole number above 0, as old Number(x) || default
allowed_deltas: the answer is the door operation's own answer (the port of the old tool over that path), not a second shape
a page path whose old owner has no door operation (growing, set-aside, keep-for, storage, release-rules, tidy, previews, leases, names, bytes) has no row
banned_substitutions: a route string in Rust source
a second store or feature in the engine
